row_id_format: f"{date} {HH:MM} pos{p}" via artifacts.row_id(h, i, p)

arrays.row_ids: int64, row index into the history array (h.nums/h.day/...)
arrays.timestamps: ISO local date and HH:MM for each evaluated target
arrays.cutoff: last observed timestamp before target; no target values
arrays.fold_id: int64, outer fold index owning that row's test window
arrays.systems: array of the exported system names (unicode strings)
arrays.baselines: array of the exported baseline names for position targets: recent500, fixed, trainfreq_frozen
arrays.available__<system>: bool[1], whether that system had a pick in every fold
arrays.config_id__<system>: unicode string per fold, the chosen config id ("" if unpicked that fold)
arrays.ranking100__<system|recent500>: uint8 (n_rows, 100), primary target only: full best-first ranking of value indices

results_arrays.row_ids: int64, matches predictions row_ids for the same target
results_arrays.y_true: int64, the true value(s): shape (n_rows,) for pos1..pos5, (n_rows, 5) for any
results_arrays.winner_rank__<system|baseline>: uint8, outcome-derived 0-based rank of the true value under the selected config (updated mode); empty when a system is unavailable
